desc:
Welcome to Dive For Brainrots!

Swim around and grab Brainrots hidden across the map! 🏊
Dive deeper to find rarer Brainrots and new areas! 🌊
Build up your Brainrot setup over time and survive longer runs! ⚡
Upgrade your base to unlock more slots and place even more Brainrots! 🏗️

Your Brainrots earn cash OFFLINE while you’re away! 💤

Like the game and join the group for FREE cash and a Brainrot! 👍
